decisions.reason: As a LED track spotlight line close to the firm's existing lighting systems, it fits its accumulated design, technical and sales-support knowledge well, so management would expect to learn from early market feedback and refine rather than withdraw it.

As a LED ceiling luminaire line that also builds directly on the firm's established competences in luminaires, planning support and dealer relationships, it is likely to be retained because the firm has strong absorptive capacity to improve and commercialise it.
